classification_rationale: Trigger (signature-verification usage) shared with req-2-signature-verification. Partially deterministic sub-check: malleability protection specifically has a well-known, checkable pattern (OpenZeppelin's ECDSA.recover enforces the low-s-value check that blocks the classic signature-malleability trick; raw ecrecover does not) -- a library-usage check is plausible and not yet evaluated for feasibility. The 4 named replay vectors (function/contract/chain scoping of the signed message, e.g. via chainid+address+nonce in the signed payload) need broader semantic review to confirm all four are actually covered by a given signing scheme.
